gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-guntur: Commanding letters stand apart, each one heavy and alone. Hind Guntur follows in a plain sans with no thick-thin shifts, so a long passage moves along like a steady cable.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-madurai: Approachable Hind Madurai fills its lines with wide-mouthed s curves and lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals, all in one ribbon-like stroke. Impact Label hits hard; Hind Madurai just talks.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-mysuru: Contemporary and unfussy, Hind Mysuru keeps its lowercase tall with no calligraphic thinning. Beside Impact Label's heavy bulk, a long passage feels light, with each a left slightly ajar.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray line of constant weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. But Impact Label is the one that shouts, with its beaded, separate letters and pincer-like c.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara traces every glyph with one thickness and spacious gaps. Impact Label delivers the heavy, commanding punch, and the sans simply carries the words with tall, open-looking bowls.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-huninn: Letters that stand alone like beads on a rod mark Impact Label, each one heavy and high-set. And Huninn does the quieter work, with lowercase rising close to cap height and crossbars as fat as the stems.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-inter-tight: Impact Label's c ends point apart like open pincers, heavy and commanding. Its strongest quality against Inter Tight is the gap in attitude: one shouts, the other hums in rope-like lines.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-karla: Impact Label sets its heavy, bead-like letters on the page with a high x-height and pincer-style c. Karla follows with a gaping c and a stocky middle band, so the two feel solid together.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri lifts its x-height skyward, with rounded letters that stay open and inviting. But Impact Label does the commanding work, heavy and separate, while the sans simply keeps the text welcoming.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-khula: Heavy beads on a rod up top, then a tall-bellied body that holds its curves open. Khula, a plain sans with its squat brush-pen midsection, makes a long passage move easily.
